what: Around a centered brand mark (24% of the panel’s short side, 40~140px), 16 thin rings stand, each widening the mark’s outline outward by 30 + 22 steps. Every 1.15s a heartbeat (big beat width .13 + a half-strength small beat .3s later) spreads from the innermost ring, delayed .085s per ring, swelling each ring by 4.5×(1+.05·index) and darkening it, while 3× and 5× waves rotate in opposite directions per ring so the outline wobbles by 1.6. The mark itself also pulses 5% with the beat (canvas 2D)

options.first: Distance of the first ring from the symbol outline (at 95-cell symbol size), default 30
options.lag: Beat delay per ring in sec, default .085
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Symbol shape — an svg with one path inside (the ring stands along that path outline). If none, a rounded rectangle

from.where: index.html right cell of the number row .sg-tile--heart

note: The original draws real contour lines at equal distance from the brand outline, but here the rings are outlines expanded from the center outward, so on concave marks the rings are a little less smooth. With reduced motion, there is no pulse and only a single line of rings
